snippet.title: Partially Realio: Bittersweet 16 Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD THE DEMO HERE!: https://gamebanana.com/mods/614257

Partially Realio is a postmodern neo-repaint of Super Paper Mario. Despite having the same framework, it is an entirely new story, with new characters and worlds inspired by classic comedy novels such as Discworld and Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy. Play as Realio, a mysterious mute bastardization of Mario as him and his team travel through Wizardtopia, a vast land fueled by the mind and our imagination. The focus on comedic worldbuilding is sure to keep you laughing the entire game, but the heavy story will keep you at the edge of your seat.

Trailer Music: https://youtu.be/J2md3a7BuLI?si=OO6XpvOmDj0PJGW7
